name: 02148 · Malden, MA
findings: ZIP 02148 (Malden) has 195 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02148 (Malden) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02148 (Malden) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
